import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n = data[0]
a = data[1:]

positions = [i for i, value in enumerate(a) if value == 1]
positions = [-1] + positions + [n]

answer = 0
for i in range(1, len(positions) - 1):
    answer += (positions[i] - positions[i - 1]) * (positions[i + 1] - positions[i])

print(answer)
